target: Portable agent platform: autonomous control, multiple harnesses, retrieval, skills, memory, coordination, observation, terminal and web; host/dotfiles external.

tasks.title: Establish the clone and complete kit validation
acceptance: All current kit checks pass with the exact validator dependencies.
Record missing host execution prerequisites separately; synthetic checks remain source evidence.

tasks.title: Select a small implementation and record host bindings
acceptance: Record module owners, exact dependency pins with live sources/date, package boundaries and six host service bindings.
Resolve final extension selection: retrieval, skills, memory, coordination, observation, terminal and web. Keep host/dotfiles external.
Review any code reuse separately, including license, retained size and dependencies; copy nothing without a later decision.

tasks.title: Probe required independent-host services
acceptance: Exercise supervision, private IPC, credential mediation, workspace isolation, immutable policy and durable-store bindings with synthetic inputs.
Required absent guarantees reject the affected integration; no fallback to unrestricted execution.

tasks.title: Implement immutable policy and canonical registries
acceptance: Equivalent launch intent produces stable identities; changed authority or bindings changes identity.
Unknown/duplicate tools, invalid combinations, foreign workspace identity and unsupported schemas are rejected.

tasks.title: Implement typed dispatch and exact approval
acceptance: Real broker validates issuer, input digest, handler, current grants and schema before dispatch.
Denial, expiry, replay, revoked grant, changed input and uncertain dispatch have independent negative tests.

tasks.title: Implement isolated execution, cancellation and cleanup
acceptance: Actual worker proves approved mounts, no unintended egress/credentials, bounded execution and read-only Git metadata.
Timeout, parent death, cancellation, hostile paths and descendant cleanup are exercised; a synthetic replay is insufficient.

tasks.title: Integrate one real registered harness and model route
acceptance: Registered adapter uses the same broker policy; native tool paths cannot bypass it.
Real request, streaming, tool correlation, cancellation and resume work; credentials stay outside harness/repo workers.
Select exact provider/adapter revisions and verified usage/pricing semantics; unknown usage remains unknown.

tasks.title: Implement task persistence, autonomous control and resume
acceptance: Real controller/storage execute success, denial, timeout, cancellation, budget exhaustion and recovery scenario oracles.
Crash/replay cannot double-dispatch effects; external waits run no model turns; completion requires current evidence.
Fresh session resumes source-bound work after interruption and reports uncertain effects without guessing.

tasks.title: Prove neutral adapters and provider shapes
acceptance: Two independent real adapters and a synthetic third use identical policy/tool and resume contracts.
Provider/authentication errors, unsupported operations and usage mapping have actual consumer tests.

tasks.title: Implement progressive retrieval and operating skills
acceptance: Real source reader/search handles byte windows, complete enumeration, stale indexes, changed continuation and unsupported languages.
Skill discovery uses compact metadata, verifies content digests and loads only selected bodies/references.
Run positive, negative and ambiguous routing cases; public/private overlays cannot shadow names or grant power.

tasks.title: Implement evidence-bound memory lifecycle
acceptance: Real evidence store distinguishes source/build/live levels, invalidates dependent results and retains unresolved evidence.
Memory candidates are reviewed separately; secret redaction, stale anchors and unavailable evidence have negative tests.

tasks.title: Implement scoped multi-agent scheduling
acceptance: Real scheduler enforces finite capacity and one writer/claimant, with scoped peer visibility and revocation.
Duplicate delivery, expired lease, conflicting claims and mixed-workspace saturation preserve authority.

tasks.title: Implement reconstructible observation
acceptance: Actual event collector/reducer reconstructs equivalent state from snapshots and cursors; gaps require resync.
Stopped/slow observation cannot stall agents or become the authority owner.

tasks.title: Implement terminal and web consumers
acceptance: Both clients drive the same Focus, Swarm and Observe scenarios over neutral contracts.
Keyboard/accessibility, scope checks and slow/disconnected clients are tested with the real platform.

tasks.title: Verify the combined complete portable platform
acceptance: Build exact artifacts and execute a realistic repo task with two adapters, isolated edits, checks and recovery.
Run required combined negative gates and final requirement-to-evidence matrix; no desktop/host setup is counted.
Permanent orientation, verification and resume work without bootstrap code; transfer required evidence before retirement.
